gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (Deficit) - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (trimmed p5, printed p9) prints Total revenues 914,002 across General 225,626, Street 185,855, Debt Service 107,599, Sales Tax 155,160, Cemetery Fund 5,347, Library Board 7,288, Community Ambulance 52,244 and Other Governmental Funds 174,883. Detail has the General, Street, Debt Service, Sales Tax budget schedules and the Other Governmental Funds (Swimming Pool p18 + nonmajor combining p21: 118,073 + 53,875 + 2,521 + 414 = 174,883) = 849,123. The Cemetery Fund, Library Board and Community Ambulance columns have no schedule. Cemetery Fund: Taxes 1,018 + Charges for services 3,982 + Interest 347 = 5,347; Library Board: Interest 23 + Miscellaneous 7,265 = 7,288; Community Ambulance: Licenses, fees, and permits 18,611 + Interest 206 + Miscellaneous 33,427 = 52,244. 849,123 + 5,347 + 7,288 + 52,244 = 914,002 = statement total.

gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns: the governmental funds statement (p5) prints Total expenditures 993,332 including Cemetery Fund 9,622 (Cemetery), Library Board 65,489 (Culture and Parks and Recreation) and Community Ambulance 38,641 (Public safety), which have no schedule and are not in detail (+113,752). (2) Different basis: the Debt Service Fund budget schedule (p16) prints Bond retirement 105,000 + Interest on bonds 53,636 + Agent fees 400 = 159,036 as disbursements (detail indexes 72, 73, 74), while the governmental funds statement prints the same Debt Service Fund amounts under Other Financing Sources (Uses) as Debt principal payments (105,000) and Debt interest payments (54,036) (p6), so its Debt Service Fund expenditure column is blank. Detail 1,038,616 = General 294,736 + Street 472,222 + Debt Service 159,036 + Other Governmental Funds 112,622. 1,038,616 + 113,752 = 1,152,368; 1,152,368 - 993,332 = 159,036 = the Debt Service schedule disbursements printed as other financing on the statement (no fix for that part; both printed as shown, p16 and p6).

gaps.explanation: Statement business-type disbursements 155,190 (Statement of Activities, p2) = proprietary total operating expenditures 116,645 + Debt payments 21,892 + Interest expense 16,653 (p8). The Water Enterprise Fund budget schedule (p19) prints Total disbursements 116,515 (incl. Interest expense 16,653) and prints Debt payments (21,892) separately under Other Financing Uses (in detail as other financing); Sewer schedule (p20) Total disbursements 16,783. 116,515 + 16,783 = 133,298; 155,190 - 133,298 = 21,892 = the Water Fund debt payments that the schedule prints as other financing and the statement total counts as a disbursement. Nothing missing; no fix.
